breakpoints.note: The staged witness begins with the 7-byte magic `!<arch>`, so `KAr::openArchive()` does not return `Invalid main magic` and proceeds into the member-header loop.
First project-code statement on the vulnerable path that reads a full ar member header from the attacker-controlled buffer into parser state.

The only preceding guard is `if (! ar_longnames)`, which proves only that a table pointer exists. The relevant fix hoists the parsed suffix into `ar_longnamesIndex` and, on this witness where the current header's blank size field also parses to `0`, rejects `8 >= size` before this assignment; the same patch hunk also adds a separate negative-size check, but the witnessed crash is the unchecked longfilename offset dereference.
